tomls.name: why each is where it is
tomls.text:
[[Customizations]]
listName = 'generated'

# Mine.esp: must load after 'A.esp'
# Mine2.esp: mlox [NearEnd] hint
# B.esp: no ordering constraint -- positional only
[[Customizations.insert]]
insertBlock = '''Mine.esp
Mine2.esp
B.esp'''
after = 'A.esp'

tomls.name: a replace breaks a run and is noted
tomls.text:
[[Customizations]]
listName = 'x'

[[Customizations.insert]]
insert = 'Mine.esp'
after = 'A.esp'

# Yours: carried through unchanged. This tool never writes a replace of
# its own -- only insert, append and remove blocks are regenerated.
# mlox sorts Mine2.esp to position 4 of 5
#   after: Mine.esp
# A replace has no after/before -- it inherits the position of source --
# so if that is not where it sits now, only you can move it: change this
# block to an insert, or leave it as it is on purpose.
[[Customizations.replace]]
source = 'Old.esp'
dest = 'Mine2.esp'

dest = 'Gone.esp'

[[Customizations.replace]]
source = 'S'

[[Customizations.replace]]
